home.root.status.title: Root Status
home.root.status.howTo: Shows whether this device is rooted. Root unlocks the memory-analysis, packet capture, evil-AP and IMSI modules. Tap to open the root pre-flight with a one-tap root re-request if access was revoked.

troubleshooting.cause: su binary present but a magisk deny-list is blocking us
troubleshooting.fix: Tap the widget → Grant Root. If you use Magisk hide/Zygisk deny-list, exclude Quantum CLI.
Root-less modules remain fully usable. Modules requiring root show the root badge in their status footer.

home.terminal.launcher.title: Terminal
home.terminal.launcher.howTo: Embedded terminal console with full command history and SAF-backed log export. Use View to open the whole session log, Download to save it via the system file picker, and Clear to start fresh. Streams from any module's 'open in terminal' land here.

troubleshooting.fix: Settings → General → Terminal theme → Quantum Mono.
Use Devices → Wireless scan + connect (the RSA prompt appears on the target).

home.net.speed.title: Network Speed
home.net.speed.howTo: Live sampled upload/download with a 60-second sparkline (TrafficStats deltas). History persists in TelemetrySamples for the charts dashboard.

troubleshooting.cause: VPN interface accounting differs on some ROMs
troubleshooting.fix: Toggle Settings → Network → Speed sample source: auto → wifi/cellular explicit.

home.model.status.title: Local AI Model
home.model.status.howTo: Status of the on-device MediaPipe model used when the provider chain falls back to local. Shows model name, size, and download progress. Tap for the Machine Learning dashboard: download (resumable), verify, unload, delete, and sampling controls.

troubleshooting.fix: Tap Retry — downloads resume; completed bytes are never redownloaded. Check free space in the ML dashboard.
Delete the model in the ML dashboard and re-download; if it recurs, switch the mirror in Settings → AI → Model mirrors.

home.provider.grid.title: Provider Status
home.provider.grid.howTo: Health grid for every configured AI provider (Abliteratus, OpenRouter, Venice, Agnes, OpenCode, local). Green = healthy ping, amber = degraded, red = unreachable, grey = not configured. Tap a provider for latency detail; long-press to set it first in the failover chain.

troubleshooting.fix: Integrations dashboard → the provider → update key; a health re-ping runs immediately.
Check Home → RDNS widget; the banner clears when the primary resolver returns.

home.dnscrypt.status.title: DNSCrypt & Resolvers
home.dnscrypt.status.howTo: Shows the dnscrypt-proxy process state and active resolver list parsed from its TOML (the same config quantum.anon generates). Tap to view resolver latency ranking and switch primary.

troubleshooting.symptom: Process green, but DoH widget amber
troubleshooting.fix: Align resolver under Settings → Network → DoH endpoint = DNSCrypt's active resolver.

home.map.preview.title: Beacon Map Preview
home.map.preview.howTo: Mini world map pinned to the full map dashboard. Green pins = live beacons; tap any pin to open the target drawer.
